root_cause.text: The esd_usb CAN-USB driver assumed RX URBs stayed on the `dev->rx_submitted` anchor after completion, but the USB core unanchors a URB before invoking `esd_usb_read_bulk_callback()`, so completed and resubmitted URBs were no longer tracked and leaked at `esd_usb_close()`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE text says URBs are “added to the dev->rx_submitted anchor and submitted” in `esd_usb_open()`, but “the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called,” so “once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in esd_usb_close()`; the patch fixes this by adding `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted);` in `esd_usb_read_bulk_callback()` and unanchoring only on submit failure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Anchor resubmitted USB read URBs and clean up failed submissions to fix URB lifecycle handling in the bulk read callback.
intent_record.what: In the USB bulk read callback, the URB is now anchored with usb_anchor_urb() before resubmission, and if usb_submit_urb() succeeds the function returns immediately. If submission fails, the URB is unanchored with usb_unanchor_urb() before handling errors. The error handling branch was also changed so that -ENODEV is handled separately, while all other errors fall through to the dev_err() logging path.
intent_record.how: This ensures resubmitted read URBs are tracked while pending, so they can be managed or canceled correctly by the driver. It also avoids leaving a successfully queued URB in an anchored state unnecessarily, and prevents a failed submission from remaining anchored. Behavior on -ENODEV remains to detach network devices, while other submission failures are still reported as errors.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it fixes RX URB lifecycle tracking in the bulk read callback by re-anchoring resubmitted URBs and handling failed submissions, preventing URBs from being lost and leaked on close.

candidates.rationale: This resubmits the completed RX URB without re-anchoring it, so the URB is no longer tracked by dev->rx_submitted and can leak when the device is closed.
